connector.name: Facet UCP Shopping
connector.registryDescription: The independent agent-commerce protocol for AI-agent checkout on any online store.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.facet.llc over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace llc.facet, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Facet KYA bearer, an ES256 JWT from the default issuer https://issuer.facet.llc (or another issuer advertised at /.well-known/agents.txt KYA-Issuers). Not required for tools/list or catalog discovery; required for gated tools/call, per the endpoint's agents.txt (MCP-Auth: kya-bearer).
